title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
description: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k-th` largest element in the array. Can you solve it without sorting the entire array?

hints.content: Sorting the array in descending order yields nums[k-1].
A min-heap of size k keeps the top k elements in O(n log k).
Quickselect finds the kth element in average O(n) time.

solution.explanation:
Sort descending and return element at index k - 1.
Time Complexity: O(n log n)
Space Complexity: O(1)
